title: Nigerian Communities Seek Compensation From Shell: Report
description: Nigerian communities are seeking $310 million in damages from Shell, alleging the company violated a court order by agreeing to sell its onshore assets in the Niger Delta before a compensation lawsuit is resolved.

title: BP Sells Stake In Gas Pipeline To Apollo, Raises $1B
description: BP is selling a non-controlling stake in its TAP subsidiary to Apollo for $1 billion, supporting its divestment goals. The deal keeps BP as the controlling shareholder while boosting capital efficiency.

title: Shell Raises Q3 Upstream Production Outlook, Revises Integrated Gas Guidance
description: Shell has raised its Q3 upstream production outlook and revised its integrated gas guidance, reflecting operational adjustments in the quarter.

title: Shell Fuels The Future: New Deal with Ferrari And Power Plant Acquisition On The Horizon
description: Shell renewed its multi-year partnership with Ferrari and announced the acquisition of a 609MW power plant in Rhode Island, securing long-term energy supply in the ISO New England market.

title: Shell's Solid Q3 Performance: Strong Revenue, $3.5 Billion Buyback, And Refined Capex Guidance
description: Shell reported a strong third-quarter performance, with higher upstream production and marketing sales driving revenue growth. The company announced a $3.5 billion buyback program and a $0.344 dividend per share. Shell also refined its capital expenditure guidance for the year.

title: Shell Wins Appeal Against Landmark Climate Ruling, Dodging Major Emission Cut Mandate
description: Shell won an appeal overturning a Dutch court ruling that required it to cut global emissions by 45% by 2030. The company's target to become a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050 remains at the heart of its strategy.

title: TotalEnergies Expands Decarbonization Efforts Through Partnership with Oil India Limited
description: TotalEnergies and Oil India Limited (OIL) have partnered to use TotalEnergies' AUSEA technology for methane emissions detection and measurement at OIL sites in India, supporting OIL's commitment to the Oil and Gas Decarbonization Charter's goals of net-zero operations by 2050 and near-zero upstream methane emissions by 2030.
